title: MZ How might I make a Devil Summoner/Shin Megami Tensei inspired game?

posts.author: RaineDesidia
posts.body:
So, the game concept I have is simple
- First Person dungeon crawler [but regular view on the world map]
- Emphasis on recruiting/capturing the monsters in the game through negotiation or other methods
- Fusing monsters together to make stronger monsters
- And some kind of row/formation type feature [resminiscient of Devil Summoner's or FF6's row feature, with back/front rows]
- Fighting alongside the monsters on the field, so theoretically someone could do a "no monsters" run of the game, even if it'll be difficult
I'm mainly trying to figure out the feasability of making something like this with RPG Maker, as that's the engine I have the most experience in.
Some examples I have here include footage from
Devil Summoner
and
Shin Megami Tensei [to be specific the RPG Maker VX remake version]
.
I deadass have not many clues as to how I could do this. I've heard that RPG Maker Unite has an official plugin for 3d dungeon crawling but I've heard mixed things about the engine in general.
I have no idea what to nor what I'm doing-

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Yeah there's MZ3D plugin that I think allows you to keep some maps the original way.
You can capture the monsters with either map or battle mechanics and add them as characters.
You probably want to write custom scene for monster fusion (or try and use some common event menu plugin).
There are some battle row plugins (at least VS has battle grid).
Don't know what you mean with "fighting alongside the monsters on the field". There are ABS plugins and you can fight with them as characters in the battle scene, but if want on map battles with different companions also moving around blasting stuff, no doubt there's better engines for that. Unless you do like AI plugins where you just overwrite most of RPG Maker.
